item.title: Sun Dec 20, 2026 · West Valley Track Club · Christmas Relays
item.description: Starts: 2026-12-20 09:00 AM (America/Los_Angeles). Meeting place: Sunset Circle parking lot, Lake Merced, Sunset Blvd and Lake Merced Blvd, San Francisco.
